answer: Each identity must plant one willow in the garden and keep it alive with a pulse: a fresh signed heartbeat every epoch. The k-th willow from one funder costs 5k units of stake, so N fakes cost 5N(N+1)/2 in total, 275 for 10 and 25,250 for 100. A garden audit burns any willow whose pulse matches another identity's, so clones cannot share one heartbeat across fakes.
